interpretation: Illustrative, in-sample portfolio construction on a five-stock universe. Optimized weights are not recommendations and are never written to dataset_holdings or config/instruments.json.
risk_free_rate_note: Illustrative effective annual INR assumption (project default), not a live RBI/FBIL rate.

constraints.note: Max weight doubles as the single-stock concentration limit. The Banking cap applies to the two bank holdings combined.

strategy_variants.note: Min-variance with sum |w - w_current| <= 20% relative to the existing weights.

transaction_costs.note: Indian delivery-equity cost components as basis points of traded value. Rates change; verify against your broker's contract note and current NSE/SEBI/state notifications before relying on them.

components.name: brokerage
components.source_note: Assumes a zero-brokerage delivery plan; set your broker's rate.

components.name: stt
components.source_note: Securities Transaction Tax on delivery equity, assumed 0.1% per side; verify current Finance Act rate.

components.name: stamp_duty
components.source_note: Stamp duty on delivery purchases, assumed 0.015%; verify the Indian Stamp Act schedule.

components.name: exchange_transaction_charge
components.source_note: NSE equity transaction charge, assumed 0.00297%; verify the current NSE circular.

components.name: sebi_turnover_fee
components.source_note: SEBI fee assumed INR 10 per crore (0.0001%); verify current SEBI rate.
